title: Ruby Beach Brewing
venue_description:
About Ruby Beach Brewing

Ruby Beach Brewing is a distinguished craft brewery situated in a beautifully renovated 119-year-old brick building in the heart of Downtown Jacksonville's Urban Core. Located just steps from the iconic Florida Theatre and the vibrant Elbow District this brewery has become a beloved destination for craft beer enthusiasts and music lovers alike.

The Brewery Experience

Ruby Beach focuses on brewing fresh innovative craft beers with a rotating draft list of 18 beers brewed on-site. Their taproom also features guest taps showcasing local ciders and meads as well as a full spirits selection making them one of the only breweries in Northeast Florida to offer both beer wine and a full liquor bar. The brewery emphasizes quality local ingredients and creative brewing techniques that appeal to discerning beer connoisseurs.

Outdoor and Indoor Spaces

The venue boasts an inviting patio space and beautifully maintained turfed backyard with ample seating for large groups. The outdoor area provides plenty of shade perfect for families with children and dog-friendly gatherings. Inside the taproom features higher-end industrial styling that pays homage to the building's historic character while providing a contemporary comfortable atmosphere.

Food and Dining

Ruby Beach Smoke the resident food truck operates seven days a week serving delicious bites to complement the brewery's beverage offerings. The food truck provides menu options until 9 PM on most nights making it easy to enjoy a complete dining and drinking experience. Sunday brunch service starts at 10 AM.

Live Music and Events

Music is central to Ruby Beach's identity. The brewery hosts weekly Sunday open mic nights starting at 7 PM with sign-ups beginning at 6:30 PM. Hosted by musician Torin Ance these open mics create a welcoming environment for musicians to perform original songs and covers. The venue regularly features live music throughout the week with performances in both the taproom and outdoor spaces.

Event Hosting

Ruby Beach Brewing offers multiple event spaces for private functions including The Lawn The Lounge and The 2nd Floor with the option to rent the entire facility. The venue accommodates weddings ceremonies corporate events intimate dinners birthday parties and more. Their flexibility in event styling and vendor selection makes them a versatile choice for special occasions.

Hours and Accessibility

The brewery operates Monday through Thursday 2 PM to 10 PM Friday 11 AM to midnight Saturday 11 AM to midnight and Sunday 10 AM to 10 PM. Easy parking access and proximity to other downtown attractions make Ruby Beach an ideal stop for both locals and visitors exploring Jacksonville's urban core.

title: Blue Jay Listening Room
venue_description:
About Blue Jay Listening Room

Blue Jay Listening Room is an award-winning intimate music venue that opened in 2017 in South Jacksonville Beach. Founded by venue director and musician Cara Murphy Blue Jay was created to address a void in the Jacksonville music scene - a dedicated space where audiences could truly listen to musicians share their original songs stories and inspirations rather than treating music as background noise.

The Listening Room Concept

Blue Jay operates on a foundational philosophy summarized as Please Be Quiet. This isn't a typical bar or restaurant gig - it's a sacred listening space where audiences silence their phones sit attentively and connect deeply with artists. The 80-capacity room creates an environment where conversation is welcomed before shows during set breaks and after performances but strongly discouraged during the music itself. Repeat violators of this policy are politely asked to leave ensuring an optimal experience for respectful listeners.

Music Programming

The venue hosts concerts nearly every night of the week featuring an impressive range of programming. Tuesday night jazz jams have become a beloved weekly tradition with professional musicians and students gathering to improvise and collaborate. A monthly bluegrass jam (typically the last Tuesday) brings together acoustic musicians for traditional picking sessions. The venue regularly presents local and internationally-touring songwriters across diverse genres from folk and Americana to jazz soul and contemporary acoustic music.

Weekly Schedule Highlights

Regular programming includes Blue Jay Jazz Jam every Tuesday night ($10 cover $5 with valid student ID) monthly Blue Jay Bluegrass Jam ($10 cover) and a variety of ticketed concerts featuring both established touring artists and emerging local talent. The venue provides professional backline for jazz jams including keyboard electric bass and amp drums and guitar amp.

Venue Atmosphere

Located upstairs from Casa Maria Mexican Restaurant in the Costa Verde Plaza at the corner of 25th Ave South and 3rd Street Blue Jay's intimate setting makes every ticket feel like a backstage pass. The space features comfortable seating intimate lighting and professional sound that allows for up-close personal connection with performers. Wine and local craft beer are available from the bar.

Artist Support

Blue Jay has established itself as a crucial platform for original music in Northeast Florida. The venue actively supports songwriters by providing a respectful listening environment that honors the heart soul and time artists invest in their craft. Regular monthly songwriter showcases give local talent opportunities to share original material with attentive audiences.

Private Events

Beyond public concerts Blue Jay is available for private event rentals including birthday parties bridal showers and even weddings. The unique intimate atmosphere makes it a memorable setting for special celebrations. Inquiries can be sent to events@bluejayjax.com.

Schedule and Tickets

Doors typically open at 7 PM with shows beginning at 8 PM unless otherwise noted. The venue's schedule varies based on programming so checking their Facebook Instagram or website calendar is recommended. Advanced tickets are available through their website for most shows while jazz and bluegrass jams accept cash payment at the door.

Community Impact

In the seven-plus years since opening Blue Jay has become an essential part of Jacksonville Beach's cultural landscape earning recognition as one of the area's premier venues for live original music. The venue's commitment to the listening room format has created a devoted community of music lovers who appreciate the opportunity to experience artists in such an intimate intentional setting.

title: Eclipse Bar & Nightclub
venue_description:
About Eclipse Bar & Nightclub

Eclipse Bar & Nightclub has established itself as Jacksonville's premier destination for authentic alternative nightlife since opening in the historic Riverside neighborhood at 4219 St Johns Avenue. This inclusive venue has built a reputation as a judgment-free zone where diverse crowds come together to enjoy live entertainment themed nights and genuine community experiences without pretense.

The Cypher Open Mic Legacy

Eclipse is home to The Cypher Open Mic Jacksonville's longest-running open mic now celebrating 16 years of continuous weekly performances. Every Thursday night The Cypher presents an all-genres showcase featuring poetry soul hip-hop singing and spoken word. Sign-ups begin at 5:30 PM with performances running from approximately 8 PM to closing. This historic open mic has become a cornerstone of Jacksonville's artistic community providing a platform for established and emerging talent alike.

Music and Entertainment

Beyond The Cypher Eclipse maintains a packed calendar of live entertainment. Friday nights feature Jacksonville's Best Karaoke creating sing-along parties that run from doors opening until close. The venue regularly hosts live bands across genres including hard rock metal tribute acts and touring performers. Past shows have included notable acts like FLAW and various regional touring bands. The professional sound system and spacious dance floor can accommodate both intimate performances and high-energy rock shows.

Weekly Themed Nights

Eclipse offers diverse programming throughout the week. Monday Night Football features wings flavored to match the teams playing courtesy of Rollin with Delta plus drink specials all night long. Country Roadhouse nights bring new country hits line dancing and rock remixes with a boots-and-hats encouraged dress code. Whiskey Wednesday hosts a monthly meet and greet on the third Wednesday. The First Saturday of each month features the Lifestyle Party hosted by pineappleparties.com Jacksonville's premier alternative lifestyle event.

Venue Layout and Amenities

The multi-space venue includes comfortable indoor and outdoor lounge areas perfect for conversation and relaxing between sets. A spacious dance floor with professional lighting creates an ideal environment for dancing and live performances. The complete full-service bar features premium spirits signature cocktails and affordable specials including their famous Fuckit Buckit drink. Multiple seating areas accommodate different moods - from active dancing to quiet conversation.

Community and Atmosphere

Eclipse prides itself on authentic Jacksonville nightlife - real people real music zero pretense. The venue welcomes all identities with an explicitly LGBTQ+ friendly policy. Open seven days a week with varying hours (typically 4 PM-2 AM weekdays 2 PM-2 AM weekends) Eclipse maintains a no-cover-charge policy for most events making it accessible to diverse audiences. Free parking eliminates a common downtown nightlife hassle.

Private Events and Rentals

The venue is available for private party rentals corporate events and special celebrations. Full event coordination services are available along with the venue's sound system bar service and flexible space configuration. VIP bottle service and reserved table options are available for groups wanting enhanced experiences.

Bar and Drink Offerings

Eclipse's full bar serves premium spirits craft cocktails beer and wine with daily drink specials. The bartending team creates both classic cocktails and house specialties. Happy hours and themed drink promotions run throughout the week coordinating with specific events and entertainment.

Location and Accessibility

Located in Riverside at 4219 St Johns Avenue Eclipse is easily accessible from multiple Jacksonville neighborhoods. The Westside location provides ample free parking - a significant advantage over downtown venues. The venue is wheelchair accessible with an ADA-compliant main entrance and accessible parking near the entrance.

title: Mudville Music Room
venue_description:
About Mudville Music Room

Mudville Music Room is an intimate listening room venue attached to Mudville Grille on Beach Boulevard in Jacksonville. This family-owned and operated establishment combines the hospitality of a neighborhood restaurant with a dedicated concert space that hosts an impressive variety of musical performances in a separate venue room from the dining area.

Listening Room Experience

The listening room format provides performers with an attentive seated audience in a professional setting. Unlike typical restaurant or bar gigs where music becomes background noise Mudville Music Room creates an environment where audiences come specifically to listen appreciate and connect with the music. This dedicated space allows both performers and listeners to experience music in an intentional focused way.

Music Programming

Mudville presents diverse musical programming throughout the month. Weekly Friday night open mics hosted by Mark Williams welcome musicians comedians storytellers poets and performers of all types for 4 to 12-minute sets. No reservations are needed for open mic participation making it an accessible opportunity for artists to share their work.

Regular Concert Series

The River City Rhythm Kings perform classic jazz from the 1920s through 1940s on the first and third Monday of each month. Their repertoire celebrates legendary artists including Louis Armstrong Fats Waller Jelly Roll Morton Bix Beiderbecke and the Dukes of Dixieland. Each performance features New Orleans-style revelry with audience participation in a Saints Go Marching In parade bringing Mardi Gras spirit to Jacksonville.

The TBA Big Band

The 16-piece TBA Big Band performs on the first and third Monday of each month showcasing the energy and sophistication of big band jazz. These performances demonstrate the venue's commitment to presenting larger ensemble formats alongside intimate singer-songwriter shows.

Singer-Songwriter Showcases

Mudville regularly features original music from local regional and touring singer-songwriters. Recent lineups have included multi-genre evenings featuring artists like Jennifer Chase (playwright-influenced songwriting) Caenyez (Jacksonville poet and songwriter) Brooke Garwood (multi-instrumentalist behind Sun Child) and Nicole Wells-Cimmino (New York-trained vocalist blending blues folk soul and gospel). These curated evenings highlight diverse voices and storytelling approaches.

Touring and Notable Artists

The venue attracts nationally recognized talent including Grammy-nominated electric violinist Carole Mayedo celebrated as the world's first female electric violinist. With a career spanning performances with Neil Young Jefferson Starship Linda Ronstadt and the Doobie Brothers Mayedo represents the caliber of artist Mudville brings to Jacksonville.

Musical Duos and Collaborations

Mudville presents evenings featuring musical partnerships such as Cindy Bear and Franc Robert (folk and blues) and My Monster Heart (singer-songwriter Lauren Fincham with pedal steel guitarist Brian Homan). These duo formats highlight the intimate nature of the venue where audiences can appreciate the interplay between musicians.

Venue Amenities and Dining

As part of Mudville Grille the venue offers full restaurant service with daily food specials and a full liquor bar. Guests can enjoy dinner alongside their concert experience combining quality dining with live music. The family-owned operation emphasizes great food great atmosphere and exceptional service.

Reservations and Information

For reservations and concert information guests can contact Dr. Marc Dickman at mdickmanjz@aol.com or 904-703-3287. While open mic nights don't require reservations ticketed concerts often benefit from advance planning given the intimate capacity of the space. Texting 904-485-0763 is another option for making reservations.

Atmosphere and Philosophy

Mudville Music Room embodies the listening room philosophy - creating a beautiful space where audiences can expand their musical knowledge be present take a deep breath and relax while experiencing high-quality performances. The venue serves both the Jacksonville music community and touring artists as a respected stop that values musicianship artistry and the connection between performer and audience.

title: Jack Rabbits
venue_description:
About Jack Rabbits

Jack Rabbits has been a cornerstone of Jacksonville's independent music scene for over 27 years serving as one of the city's most beloved and comfortable venues for original live music. Located at 1528 Hendricks Avenue in the Southbank San Marco neighborhood directly across from the Balis Community Center this 300-capacity club is easily identifiable by its signature logo on the door.

Music Programming and Genre Diversity

Jack Rabbits specializes in original music across an impressive range of genres including singer-songwriter indie-rock punk jam music Americana reggae metal and hardcore. The venue's show schedule features mostly national and touring acts that regularly include Jacksonville as a tour stop knowing it's one of the most popular venues to play in the region. The club has earned a stellar reputation for booking quality up-and-coming and legendary musicians particularly in the indie underground reggae and metal spectrums.

Legendary Performances

Over 27 years Jack Rabbits has hosted thousands of concerts and maintained an impressive batting average for bringing in notable talent. The venue has become a tour-stop favorite for influential indie artists including Mike Watt Melvins Built to Spill and Southern Culture on the Skids. This legacy of quality booking has established Jack Rabbits as an essential venue for serious music fans and touring artists alike.

Venue Atmosphere

Jack Rabbits embraces a no-frills approach focusing on what matters most: cold beer quality live sound and music most nights of the week. The intimate 300-person capacity means audiences are always close to the action creating the perfect environment for experiencing music up close and personal. The smaller venue size is particularly well-suited to the punk rock and metal feeling where the crowded space enhances the energy of performances.

All-Ages and Family-Friendly

Although Jack Rabbits serves beer and wine the venue maintains an all-ages atmosphere that welcomes families. This policy allows parents to keep an eye on their teens while younger music fans can experience quality live performances. Most shows are all ages though under-21 patrons cannot re-enter once inside. The inclusive approach helps develop the next generation of music fans and musicians.

Staff and Community

The staff at Jack Rabbits exemplifies the venue's friendly laid-back atmosphere. Known for being welcoming and knowledgeable the team creates a comfortable environment that feels as welcoming as the people who work there. This approachable vibe has helped Jack Rabbits build a loyal community of regular attendees and become a true neighborhood gathering spot for music lovers.

Local Music Support

While primarily known for touring acts Jack Rabbits also supports local Jacksonville musicians providing a professional stage for homegrown talent. Local bands across all genres find opportunities to perform often as openers for national acts or on dedicated local showcases. This mix of touring and local acts strengthens Jacksonville's overall music ecosystem.

Sound and Production

The venue provides quality sound production with professional equipment and experienced sound engineers. The smaller stage and room size actually enhance the audio experience allowing for excellent clarity and volume without the sound issues sometimes found in larger venues. Musicians and audiences alike praise the venue's acoustic properties and professional approach to live sound.

Show Logistics

Most shows at Jack Rabbits run a cover charge typically starting around $10-12 even for shows featuring primarily local bands. Doors and show times vary by event. The venue operates most nights of the week maintaining a consistently active schedule that gives Jacksonville music fans regular opportunities to see live performances.

Location and Accessibility

Situated in the San Marco area Jack Rabbits benefits from a central Jacksonville location that's accessible from multiple neighborhoods. The Hendricks Avenue address puts it in a walkable neighborhood with nearby restaurants and businesses creating opportunities for a full evening out around the show.

Cultural Significance

For over a quarter century Jack Rabbits has served as an essential institution in Jacksonville's music scene. The venue represents a commitment to original music artist-friendly policies and quality programming that has helped put Jacksonville on the map for touring musicians. Many bands specifically plan their tour routes to include Jacksonville because of the venue's reputation and the enthusiastic audiences it attracts.

title: The Parlour
venue_description:
About The Parlour

The Parlour is a hidden gem speakeasy located at 2000 1/2 San Marco Boulevard nestled behind The Grape & Grain Exchange in the heart of historic San Marco Square. Since opening in November 2012 as part of the Grape & Grain Exchange concept this intimate venue has become one of Jacksonville's most beloved destinations for craft cocktails and live music combining retro Prohibition-era ambiance with modern craft beverage culture.

The Speakeasy Experience

The Parlour captures the essence of a 1920s speakeasy with its hidden entrance intimate atmosphere and carefully curated aesthetic. The space features a mix of modern chic and vintage charm with comfortable seating intimate lighting and eclectic decor that creates a stylish environment perfect for date nights social gatherings and experiencing live music. The 75-person capacity ensures an exclusive feeling where every guest receives personal attention.

Garden to Glass Philosophy

The Parlour pioneered the Garden to Glass cocktail movement in Jacksonville working closely with local farms to source seasonal ingredients for their handcrafted cocktails. This concept - rooted in the Farm to Table movement - demonstrates the utmost care in producing superior cocktails using locally-sourced fresh ingredients. The bar has earned recognition from Slow Foods First Coast as the first cocktail bar awarded a Snail of Approval for their work with local farms.

Craft Beverage Program

The beverage menu showcases creative cocktails that change seasonally to reflect available local ingredients. Beyond cocktails The Parlour serves a curated selection of artisanal beers and fine wines. The skilled bartending team provides personalized recommendations helping guests discover drinks that match their tastes. The bar supports local businesses including breweries coffee roasters and distilleries as part of their commitment to the Jacksonville community.

Live Music Programming

Music is central to The Parlour's identity with regular live performances on weekends featuring talented local musicians. The venue has become known for its vibrant jazz programming though it presents artists across multiple genres. The intimate setting creates an ideal environment for experiencing music where audiences feel connected to performers. The combination of quality cocktails and live music makes The Parlour a distinctive cultural destination.

Weekly Programming

The Parlour hosts themed events throughout the month creating varied experiences for regular guests and newcomers. Weekend live music has become a signature offering with performances that complement the sophisticated cocktail environment. Happy hour runs from 4 PM to 7 PM Sunday through Thursday offering an opportunity to experience the venue's craft at more accessible pricing.

Atmosphere and Clientele

The venue attracts a diverse crowd of locals and visitors seeking authentic Jacksonville nightlife experiences. Described as hipster trendy and classy The Parlour maintains a somewhat loud environment particularly during live music though the volume adds to the energetic atmosphere. The speakeasy vibe creates a sense of discovery - it's been called Jacksonville's worst kept secret - where guests feel they've found something special.

Food and Dining

While The Parlour focuses primarily on beverages and music they welcome food from Casa Maria the adjacent Mexican restaurant. This partnership allows guests to enjoy full dining experiences alongside their drinks. The relationship with neighboring businesses creates a complementary ecosystem in San Marco Square.

Connection to Grape & Grain Exchange

The Parlour exists as part of the larger Grape & Grain Exchange concept which includes a retail liquor store and tasting room. This integrated approach combines retail craft cocktail service and live music in one location. Guests can enjoy drinks in the retail space while people-watching on San Marco Square or retreat to The Parlour for a more intimate experience.

Event Hosting

The venue is available for private events including birthday parties and special celebrations. Event packages can be customized for gatherings taking advantage of the unique speakeasy setting. Inquiries about private events can be directed to venue management.

Hours and Access

The Parlour operates Tuesday through Sunday with hours typically from 5 PM to midnight Tuesday through Thursday and 5 PM to 2 AM Friday and Saturday. Sunday hours run until midnight. The venue accepts credit cards and takes reservations making it accessible for planned visits.

Awards and Recognition

Beyond the Slow Foods Snail of Approval The Parlour has earned recognition in local media as one of Jacksonville's top cocktail bars and music venues. The combination of craft beverage expertise and commitment to live music has established it as a cultural anchor in the San Marco neighborhood.

Community Impact

The Parlour's dedication to showcasing local musicians supporting local farms and partnering with area businesses has enriched Jacksonville's cultural landscape. By creating a platform for artists to perform in an intimate respectful setting while serving locally-sourced craft cocktails The Parlour embodies a commitment to authentic community-focused hospitality that has made it an essential part of San Marco's identity.
